key_insight: Intense gusts trigger complex non-equilibrium dynamics in wall-bounded turbulence, significantly increasing the occurrence of extreme near-wall events.
engineering_relevance: Understanding these mechanisms is crucial for designing robust flow control systems for unmanned aerial vehicles in unsteady atmospheric conditions.
method: Direct numerical simulations (DNS) to analyze turbulence dynamics.
Use of spectral and continuous wavelet analyses to investigate energy redistribution.
Two-step conditional averaging technique to examine triggering mechanisms.
evidence_signal: High-amplitude gusts were found to suppress high-frequency fluctuations and reorganize turbulent energy into low-frequency coherent structures.
watch_item: The study's findings may vary under different atmospheric conditions not covered in the simulations.
paper_title: Triggering of extreme events and coherent-structure modulation in wall-turbulence under cyclostationary forces
